one_liner.value: Podio offers a RESTful API secured via OAuth2 for CRM and workflow automation.
one_liner.quote: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication.

gating_notes.value: Register an app to obtain client ID/secret; free plan provides API access without additional approval.
gating_notes.quote: Before you can use the Podio API you must register your application...Your application is assigned a unique identifier, called "Client ID", together with a "Client Secret".

oauth_details.value: Supports OAuth2 server‑side, client‑side, username/password (resource‑owner password) and app authentication flows.
oauth_details.quote: Podio supports four different ways of authenticating...Server-side flow...Client-side flow...Username & password flow...App authentication flow

auth_methods.quote: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication.

primary_auth.quote: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication.

api_type.quote: The Podio API is a complete programmable interface to all Podio functionality.

api_breadth.quote: Actions, Alerts, App market, Applications, Batch, Calendar, ... (many endpoints)
